definition.en: The Zhou kings granted rights over land and people to relatives and allies, creating regional states. This is not the same institution as European feudalism.
definition.zh: 【待译】The Zhou kings granted rights over land and people to relatives and allies, creating regional states. This is not the same institution as European feudalism.

definition.en: Rulers of regional states who formally acknowledged the Zhou king, although their effective independence increased.
definition.zh: 【待译】Rulers of regional states who formally acknowledged the Zhou king, although their effective independence increased.

definition.en: An idea of the inhabited political world under a king. Its scope changed over time and does not simply mean the territory of modern China.
definition.zh: 【待译】An idea of the inhabited political world under a king. Its scope changed over time and does not simply mean the territory of modern China.

definition.en: A changing cultural and political identity used in Zhou-era texts. The contrast with Rong, Di, Yi and Man reflects the categories of those texts, not fixed modern ethnic boundaries.
definition.zh: 【待译】A changing cultural and political identity used in Zhou-era texts. The contrast with Rong, Di, Yi and Man reflects the categories of those texts, not fixed modern ethnic boundaries.

definition.en: A leading regional lord who convened alliances and claimed to uphold the Zhou order. Later lists of the hegemons disagree.
definition.zh: 【待译】A leading regional lord who convened alliances and claimed to uphold the Zhou order. Later lists of the hegemons disagree.

definition.en: A meeting at which rulers or ministers made an agreement and swore an oath. Excavated covenant texts show that such agreements could be written on stone or jade.
definition.zh: 【待译】A meeting at which rulers or ministers made an agreement and swore an oath. Excavated covenant texts show that such agreements could be written on stone or jade.

term.en: Honour the king, repel the Yi
term.zh: 【待译】Honour the king, repel the Yi

definition.en: A later formula associated with Qi leadership: supporting the Zhou king and opposing groups classified as outsiders. The wording presents the Zhou states’ perspective.
definition.zh: 【待译】A later formula associated with Qi leadership: supporting the Zhou king and opposing groups classified as outsiders. The wording presents the Zhou states’ perspective.

definition.en: Fighting with horse-drawn vehicles accompanied by infantry. The balance between chariots, infantry, crossbows and cavalry changed across the period.
definition.zh: 【待译】Fighting with horse-drawn vehicles accompanied by infantry. The balance between chariots, infantry, crossbows and cavalry changed across the period.

definition.en: Changes to law, taxation, farming, military recruitment or official appointment intended to increase a ruler’s control and resources.
definition.zh: 【待译】Changes to law, taxation, farming, military recruitment or official appointment intended to increase a ruler’s control and resources.

definition.en: A later label for thinkers and practices associated with explicit standards, rewards, punishments and ruler authority. It did not name a single organized school in this period.
definition.zh: 【待译】A later label for thinkers and practices associated with explicit standards, rewards, punishments and ruler authority. It did not name a single organized school in this period.

definition.en: Territorial units governed by appointed officials rather than hereditary regional rulers. Their development differed between states.
definition.zh: 【待译】Territorial units governed by appointed officials rather than hereditary regional rulers. Their development differed between states.

definition.en: A hierarchy in which recorded military service could earn status and privileges. Qin records linked rewards to counted enemy heads; those counts require critical reading.
definition.zh: 【待译】A hierarchy in which recorded military service could earn status and privileges. Qin records linked rewards to counted enemy heads; those counts require critical reading.

definition.en: An alliance among several states, usually described as cooperation against Qin. Its members and commitments changed.
definition.zh: 【待译】An alliance among several states, usually described as cooperation against Qin. Its members and commitments changed.

definition.en: Arrangements in which individual states dealt separately with Qin. Later narratives organize fluid diplomacy into a contrast with vertical alliances.
definition.zh: 【待译】Arrangements in which individual states dealt separately with Qin. Later narratives organize fluid diplomacy into a contrast with vertical alliances.

definition.en: A bow mounted on a stock with a trigger mechanism. Surviving bronze triggers and texts document its military use.
definition.zh: 【待译】A bow mounted on a stock with a trigger mechanism. Surviving bronze triggers and texts document its military use.

definition.en: A matching authorization token divided between a ruler and a commander. Joining the halves helped verify an order to mobilize troops.
definition.zh: 【待译】A matching authorization token divided between a ruler and a commander. Joining the halves helped verify an order to mobilize troops.

definition.en: A conventional name for competing traditions of argument about ethics, government and society. It does not refer to an exact count of schools.
definition.zh: 【待译】A conventional name for competing traditions of argument about ethics, government and society. It does not refer to an exact count of schools.
